data.name: Flesh Reactor
data.detailed_description:
STORY & SETTING

On the frozen dwarf planet Eris, a remote research facility has gone silent. Cut off from all outside contact, its corridors now crawl with a fanatical cult twisting science to serve something inhuman. As you fight to survive, you’ll uncover the truth behind the mutations and experiments, and the desperate struggle to escape and expose what happened here.

GAMEPLAY
Flesh Reactor is a single-player top-down shooter where resources are scarce and hazards are aplenty. You’ll face human cultists, twisted mutated creatures, insane cyborgs and automatic security systems. You'll need to fight, dodge, hack or misdirect to survive.

Exploration is key to survival. Every room may hide resources, access keys, information, or dangers waiting to be triggered.

Craft weapons, ammunition, and specialised devices to give yourself an edge in combat. Upgrade your abilities with experimental mutations or enhanced technology, shaping your capabilities to match your preferred tactics.

Multiple paths and approaches often give you more than one way to deal with a challenge. You might hack a turret to cover your advance, bypass danger through an alternate route, or go in guns blazing. Adapting your approach to the situation can mean the difference between survival and death.

CAMPAIGNS

The game will launch with two campaigns; Dysnomia and Flesh Reactor. The demo includes only the Dysnomia campaign. Both campaigns will be available in the full version, with the possibility of more campaigns in future updates.
